description: One dataset with one row per record. Title rows carry metadata, ratings, cast, awards, box office (budget, domestic/international/worldwide gross, opening weekends), keywords, companies, AKAs, release dates, trailers and rating breakdown; review rows carry reviewer, rating, text, helpfulness votes and spoiler flag; episode rows carry season/episode numbers and the parent series; every row carries sourceUrl. Filter by the recordType field.
